drivingQuestion: Which case does the mishna exclude by requiring that the water be drunk to quench thirst?
outcomeNote: Rav Idi bar Avin's exclusion answers the question and is not challenged within this unit.

segments.he: וְהַשּׁוֹתֶה מַיִם לִצְמָאוֹ וְכוּ׳: לְאַפּוֹקֵי מַאי? אֲמַר רַב אִידֵּי בַּר אָבִין: לְאַפּוֹקֵי לְמַאן
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that the tanna’im disagreed with regard to one who «drinks water» to quench «his thirst.» The Gemara asks: «What does» this emphasis on his thirst come «to exclude? Rav Idi bar Avin said:» It comes «to exclude one»
«who was choked by a piece of meat» and drank water in order to wash it down. He need not recite a blessing.

moves.cueHe: אמר רב אידי בר אבין: לאפוקי למאן
moves.summary: it excludes one choked by meat, whose answer runs on into berakhot.45a.1
moves.about: the qualification excludes one who drank water to wash down a piece of meat that was choking him
